spans.s:
mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Happy, prosperous.
n. adv. (-सं)
1 Happy, well, right.
subst.
2 BRAHMA, the Supreme

Being.
3

Happiness, prosperity.
E.
श्वस् particle, implying happiness, श्रेयस् [] best, excellent, and a final अच् or vowel added to the compound.

(इ) श्वकि r. 1st cl. (श्वंकते)
To go, to move.

r. 1st cl. (ष्वक्कते)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Own, proper, peculiar.
E.
स्व as above, and कन् added.

m. (-डी)
A dog-feeder or trainer.
E.
श्व, and क्रीडिन् who plays with.

(इ) श्वगि r. 1st cl. (श्वंगति)
To go or move.

(इ) स्वगि r. 1st cl. (स्वंगति)
To go, to move.

m. (-णः)
A pack or number of dogs.
E.
श्व a dog, and गण a troop.

m. (-कः)
A hunter.
mf. (-कः-का)
1 A dog feeder.
2 One carried by dogs.
E.
श्व a dog, गण a number, and ठन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A hunter.
mf. (-कः-की)
1 A dog-keeper, one who lives by feeding or keeping dogs.
2 One who rides or is drawn by dogs.
E.
श्वगण a number of dogs, ठञ् aff.

r. 1st cl. (श्वचते) (इ) श्वचि (श्वंचते)
To go, to move.

r. 1st cl. (श्वजते) also (इ) श्वजि (श्वंजते)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Self-born, produced in or by one's self.
m. (-जः)
1 A son.
2 Sweat, perspiration.
n. (-जं)
Blood.
f. (-जा)
A daughter.
E.
स्व own, self, and ज born.

r. 10th cl. (श्वाठयति) (इ) श्वठि (श्वण्ठयति)
1 To finish.
2 To leave defective or unfinished.
3 To go, to move.
(श्वठयति)
1 To speak amiss.
2 To speak well.
3 To abstain from speaking: see शठ.

r. 10th cl. (स्वठयति)
1 To finish.
2 To leave unfinished.

f. (-ष्ट्रा)
1 A dog's tooth.
2 A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
E.
श्व for श्वन् a dog, दंष्ट्रा a tooth.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A jackal.
E.
श्वन् a dog, and धूर्त्त a cheat.

m. (-श्वा श्वानौ श्वानः) accu. plu. (शुनः)
A dog.
f. (शुनी)
A bitch.
E.
श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, form irr.

nf. (-शं-शा)
A night on which dogs bark and howl.
E.
श्व for श्वन् a dog, निशा night.

mf. (-चः-चा)
1 A man or woman of a low and degraded caste.
2 A dog-feeder or keeper.
E.
श्वन् a dog, पच to cook (for his food), or to cherish as his property, and अच् aff.; also with क्विप् aff. श्वपच् m. (-पक्) and with अण् aff. श्वपाक.

n. (-दं)
1 A dog's foot^1.
2 A mark like one, to be branded on the forehead of a thief.
E.
श्व, and पद a foot.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Ferocious, savage, relating or belonging to a beast of prey.
m. (-दः)
A beast of prey in general.
E.
श्वन् a dog, आपद to resemble, aff. अच्; or श्वपद with अण् added.

m. (-दः)
A wild beast.
E.
स substituted for शः see श्वापद.

m. (-कः)
A man of a degraded and outcast tribe, the son of an Ugrā woman by a Kṣatrī male, and classed with the Caṇḍāla, with whom he is ordered to live out of the town, to feed from broken vessels, and wear the clothes of the dead; to possess no other property than asses and dogs, and to be excluded from all intercourse with other tribes; he can only be employed as public executioner, or to carry out the bodies of those who die without kindred.
E.
श्व a dog, पच to cook, (to feed on or to cherish,) aff. अण्: see श्वपच.

m. (-लः)
The lime or citron.
E.
श्व for श्वन् a dog, and फल fruit.

m. (-रुः)
A jackal.
E.
श्वन् a dog, and भीरु afraid of.

r. 10th cl. (श्वभ्रयति)
1 To live in misery or distress.
2 To go, to move.
3 To make a hole, to pierce or perforate.

n. (-भ्रं)
A hole, a gap, a chasm.
E.
श्वभ्र to pierce, aff. अच्, or श्व a dog, भृ to cherish, aff. क.

m. (-थुः)
Swelling, intumescence.
E.
श्वि to swell, aff. अथुच्.

f. (-चिः)
Sickness, disease.
E.
श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. ईचि.

r. 10th cl. (श्वर्त्तयति)
1 To live in misery or distress.
2 To go, to move.

r. 10th cl. (ष्वर्त्तयति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To be wretched or distressed.

r. 10th cl. (स्वर्त्तयति)
To be miserable or distrest.

r. 1st cl. (श्वलति)
To run, to go quickly.

r. 1st cl. (श्वल्लति)
To run, to go fast or quickly.

r. 10th cl. (श्वल्कयति)
To speak.

ind.
Like a dog, cur-like.
E.
श्व, and वति aff.

m. (-वान्)
A dog-feeder or trainer.
E.
श्व, and मतुप aff.

m. (-त्तिः)
Service, servitude.
E.
श्व a dog, and वृत्ति practice.

f. (-त्तिः)
Own, or peculiar duty or occupation.
E.
स्व, and वृत्ति profession.

m. (-घ्रः)
The hunting leopard or Ciṭa.
E.
श्व a dog, and व्याघ्र a tiger.

m. (-रः)
1 A father-in-law, a wife's or husband's father.
2 A venerable man, one to be treated as a father-in-law.
m. du. (-रौ)
A father and mother-in-law.
E.
शु a particle, implying respect, अश to pervade, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A brother-in-law, a wife's or husband's brother.
2 A husband's younger brother.
E.
श्वशुर a father-in-law, and यत् patronymic aff.

f. (-श्रूः)
A mother-in-law.
E.
श्वशुर a father-in-law, the उ and अ rejected, र conjoined with श, and ऊङ् fem. aff.

m. du. (-रौ)
Mother and father-in-law.
E.
श्वश्रू, and श्वशुर conjoined.

r. 2nd cl. (श्वसिति)
1 To breathe.
2 To live.
With आङ् prefixed,
To recover or revive, to console.
With उत्,
1 To open, to expand.
2 To console.
With निर्,
1 To breathe out, to expire.
2 To sigh.
With वि,
To have trust or faith in.

m. (-सः)
1 Breath, breathing.
2 Air, wind.
3 Sighing, a sigh.
E.
श्वस to breathe, aff. ण.

ind.
1 To-morrow.
2 A particle, implying auspiciousness.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सती-सत्)
Breathing, sighing.
E.
श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.

m. (-नः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)
n. (-नं)
1 Breathing, breath.
2 Sighing.
E.
श्वस to breathe, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-नः)
A snake.
E.
श्वसन breathing, असन food; eating air.

m. (-रः)
A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
E.
श्वसन breath, and ईश्वर sovereign.

m. (-कः)
A snake.
E.
श्वसन breathing, and उत्सुक delighting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sighed, breathed, sighing, breathing.
n. (-तं)
1 Breathing, breath.
2 Sighing, a sigh.
E.
श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well fed.
E.
सु, and आशित eaten.

m. (-तः)
A plant, (Conyza lacera, &c.)
E.
श्व a dog, and सुत a son.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Future, what will be to-morrow, &c.
E.
श्वस् to-morrow, ट्युल् aff.

mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
To-morrow's, what will be to-morrow.
E.
श्वस् to-morrow, and त्यप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Touched by a dog, defiled.
E.
श्व, and स्पृष्ट touched.

m. (-न्तः)
A dog's tooth.
E.
श्वन a dog, दन्त a tooth, and the vowel termination of the first word made long in this and similar compounds, as श्वाकर्ण, श्वापुच्छ, &c.

m. (-नः)
A dog.
f. (-नी)
A bitch.
E.
a various reading of श्वन्, q. v.

r. 1st. cl. (स्वनति)
1 To sound.
(स्वनयति)
To dress, to adorn.
With वि or अव prefixed, in a limited sense, the initial is changed,
(अवष्वणति or विष्वणति)
To make a noise whilst eating.

m. (-नः)
Sound in general.
E.
स्वन to sound, aff. अप्.

m. (-नः)
Sound, noise.
E.
स्वन to sound, aff. घञ्.

m. (-विद् or वित्)
A porcupine.
E.
श्वन् a dog, आङ् before व्यध to pierce, aff. क्विप्.

n. (-श्वः)
BHAIRAVA, or ŚIVA, in a terrific form.
E.
श्व a dog, and अश्व a horse, being usually represented mounted on a dog.

n. (-णं)
Breathing through the nostrils for a few seconds as a religious exercise: see प्राणायाम.
E.
श्वास inspiration, प्रश्वास expiration, and धारण holding or checking.

f. (-तिः)
Sleep, sleepiness.
E.
श्वास breathing or sighing, and हेति a weapon.

m. (-रिः)
A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi.
E.
श्वास breath, and अरि hostile.

m. (-सी)
Air, wind.
E.
श्वास breath, and इनि aff.

r. 1st cl. (स्वजते)
To embrace.

r. 1st cl. (स्वदते) r. 10th cl. (स्वादयति)
1 To taste.
2 To be pleasing.
3 To cover; also स्वाद.

r. 1st cl. (स्वदते)
1 To taste.
2 To be sweet or agreeable; also ष्वद.

r. 1st cl. (स्वादते)
To taste.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (स्वादति स्वादयति)
To be agreeable or pleasing.
r. 10th cl. (स्वादयति)
To cover; also ष्वद.

m. (-दः)
1 Taste, flavour.
2 Tasting, either food or drink, eating, drinking.
E.
स्वाद to taste, aff. अच्.

(ञि औ) ञिष्वपौ r. 2nd cl. (स्वपिति)
To sleep.

m. (-पः)
1 Sleep, sleeping.
2 Sleepiness, sloth.
3 Paralysis, palsy, loss of sensation.
4

Ignorance.
5

Dreaming, a dream.
6 Temporary and partial palsy from pressure on a nerve, numbness, the sleep of a limb, &c.
E.
ष्वप to sleep, aff. घञ्.

r. 1st cl. (ष्वष्कते)
To go, to move: the radical sibilant is unchanged.

r. 1st cl. (स्वस्कते)
To go, more generally read ष्वष्क.

Pron. mfn. (स्वः स्वा स्वं)
Own.
Subst. m. (स्वः)
1 A kinsman.
2 The soul.
3 Self-identity, individuality.
n. (स्वं)
1 Wealth, property.
2 (In algebra,) Plus, or affirmative quantity.
E.
स्वन to sound, aff. ड, or षू to send or order, व aff.

m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
E.
स्व self, कम्पन agitating.

m. (-कृत्)
An independant workman, one doing business on his own account.
E.
स्व own, कर्म्म business, and कृत् who does.

n. (-र्म्मा)
Own act, business, duty, conduct, &c.
E.
स्व, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Suffering the consequences of one's own acts.
E.
स्वकर्म्म, and वश subject to.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Who or what adheres to its own business or duty.
E.
स्वकर्म्म, and स्थ staying.

n. (-य्य)
Own business or duty.
E.
स्व, and कार्य्य act.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Of one's own family.
2 Own in general, as property, &c.
E.
स्व own, छ aff., and कुक् augment.

n. (-म्बं)
Own family.
E.
स्व, and कुटुम्ब family.

n. (-लं)
Own family or race.
E.
स्व, and कुल race.

m. (-यः)
A fish.
E.
स्व own, कुल race, and क्षय destruction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done or made by one's self, self-performed.
E.
स्व, and कृत done.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा or क्षी-क्षं)
1 Handsome-eyed.
2 Acute, sensitive, having keen organs.
E.
सु good, अक्षि the eye, or अक्ष an organ of sense.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Kept to one's self, apart, aside.
n. (-तं)
Aside (in theatrical language.)
E.
स्व self, गत gone, got.

n. (-तं)
Welcome, salutation.
f. (-ता)
A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
E.
सु well, and आगत come.

m. (-हः)
A small bird, (Loxia Philippensis.)
n. (-हं)
Own house.
E.
स्व own, गृह house.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Self-defended or preserved.
f. (-प्ता)
Cowach, (Carpogon pruriens.)
E.
स्व self, गुप्त preserved.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Handsome and well-shaped.
E.
सु excellent, अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
1 Healthy, sound, convalescent.
2

White.
3

Pure, free from stain or soil.
4 Transparent, pellucid.
E.
सु exceedingly, and अच्छ clean, clear.

f. (-ता)
Purity, transparency, &c.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, स्वच्छत्वं.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
1 Unrestrained, uncontrolled, self-willed.
2

Spontaneous.
3

Uncultivated.
E.
स्व own, and छन्द inclination; also स्वच्छन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं).

n. (-त्रं)
Talc.
E.
स्वच्छ transparent, and पत्र a leaf, a layer.

m. (-नः)
A distant kinsman.
E.
स्व own, जन man.

f. (-तिः)
Own caste, tribe, or species.
E.
स्व, and जाति sort.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of one's own tribe, caste, species, &c.
E.
स्व, and जातीय of a caste, &c.

f. (-तिः)
Kindred, kin.
m. (-तिः)
A kinsman.
E.
स्व, and ज्ञाति kin.

mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं)
1 Unrestrained, uncontrolled, self-willed.
2 Independant, free.
3 Full grown, of age, no longer subject to the authority of parents, &c.
E.
स्व own, तन्त्र inclination, will.

f. (-ता)
Independence, wilfulness.
E.
तल् added to the last.

ind.
1 Of itself, by one's self.
2 Own, peculiar.
E.
स्व self, तसि aff.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Self-preserving.
m. (-त्रः)
A blind man.
E.
स्व self, and त्र who preserves.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Self-existence, independant being or condition.
2 Own right or property, ownership, proprietary right.
E.
स्व own, and त्व aff. of the abstract; also स्वत्ता.

f. (-त्तिः)
Cessation or loss of proprietary right.
E.
स्वत्व, and निवृत्ति cessation.

n. (-नं)
Indication or proof of ownership.
E.
स्वत्व, and बोधन making known.

n. (-त्वं)
Doubt or uncertainty of ownership.
E.
स्वत्व, and व्यभिचारित्व want of steadiness.

f. (-निः)
Loss or forfeiture of proprietary title or right.
E.
स्वत्व, and हानि loss.

m. (-तुः)
Ground or cause of proprietary right.
E.
स्वत्व, and हेतु cause.

m. (-वः)
Non-existence of proprietary right.
E.
स्वत्व, and अभाव non-existence.

m. (-मः)
Determination or ascertainment of ownership.
E.
स्वत्व, and अवगम certainty.

n. (-दं)
The subject or thing in which proprietary right is vested.
E.
स्वत्व, and आस्पद site.

f. (-त्तिः)
Origin or production of proprietary right.
E.
स्वत्व, and उत्पत्ति production.

n. (-नं)
Eating.
E.
स्वद to taste, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Tasting, either as food or drink, eating, drinking.
E.
स्वाद to taste, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uxorious, devoted to a wife.
E.
स्व own, दार wife, निरत attached to.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eaten, well eaten.
n. (-तं)
The term used after presenting food to the manes, asking if they are satisfied.
E.
स्वद to taste, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tasted, touched with the lips.
E.
स्वाद to taste, aff. क्त.

m. (-शः)
1 Native country, home.
2 Own or proper place.
E.
स्व, and देश country.

m. (-धिः)
Circumference of a circle of longitude in any place that has latitude.
E.
स्वदेश, and परिधि circumference.

m. (-धिः)
Circumference of the terrestrial equator.
E.
स्वदेश, मध्य centre, and परिधि circumference.

n. (-र्म्मं)
1 Peculiar duty or occupation, as praying of a Brahman, fighting of a soldier, &c.
2 Property, peculiarity.
E.
स्व own, धर्म्म virtue.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Neglecting one's duty.
E.
स्वधर्म्म, and च्युत fallen from.

m. (-गः)
1 Neglect of duty.
2 Apostacy.
E.
स्वधर्म्म, and त्याग abandonment.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Attached to or performing one's peculiar duty.
E.
स्वधर्म्म, and स्थ who or what stays.

n. (-नं)
Neglecting or disregarding duty.
E.
स्वधर्म्म, and स्खलन slipping.

ind.
1 An exclamation used on presenting an oblation to the manes. (aptote noun).
2 The food of deceased ancestors.
f. (-धा)
1 A personification of Māyā or worldly illusion, the self-contained associate of the

Creator.
2

A nymph, the food of the manes personified, and sometimes represented as the wife of AGNI or fire.
E.
ष्वद to taste, आ aff., and द changed to ध; or स्व self, धा to hold, aff. अ and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
Pronouncing the exclamation Svadhā.
E.
स्वधा, and कार making; also स्वधाकर.

m. (-यः)
1 Black sesamum.
2 AGNI or fire.
E.
स्वधा the exclamation used in making oblations to the manes, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-भुक्)
1 A divine or deified ancestor.
2 A deity.
E.
स्वधा the food of the manes, and भुज् who eats.

mf. (-तिः-ती)
An axe.
E.
स्व self, धा to hold, क्तिन् aff.; also श्वधिति.

m. (-कः)
A soldier armed with an axe.
E.
स्वधिति an axe, and हेतिक armed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well read, versed in.
E.
सु, and अधीत read.

n. (-रं)
Own or native town.
E.
स्व, and नगर city.

mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्)
Sounding.
E.
स्वन to sound, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sounding, thundering.
E.
स्वन sound, मतुप् aff.

m. (-शः)
Self-destruction.
E.
स्व, and नाश loss.

m. (-निः)
Sound, noise.
E.
स्वन to sound, इन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, sounding, making a noise.
n. (-तं)
The noise of thunder.
E.
स्वन to sound, aff. क्त, or स्वन sound, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well or duly observed, practised, performed, &c.
E.
सु well, अनुष्ठित followed.
